sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture and Aseptic Tubing of Ambient Quick-Cook Tapioca Pearls

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Hong Kong SAR (parent/investor jurisdiction) and People's Republic of China mainland (target WFOE jurisdiction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Mainland and Hong Kong Closer Economic Partnership Arrangement (CEPA) and its Investment Agreement
Arrangement between the Mainland of China and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for the Avoidance of Double Taxation on Income and on Capital Gains (Mainland-Hong Kong DTA)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: People's Republic of China Anti-Money Laundering Law (2006, as revised effective 1 January 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information (PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); Measures for Financial Institutions' Customer Identity Identification and Transaction Information Preservation (PBOC Order No. 2 [2006]); applicable SAMR and State Taxation Administration beneficial-owner information sharing rules.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Hong Kong shareholder or ultimate parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: notarize a certified copy before a Hong Kong Notary Public, then obtain an apostille from the Apostille Section of the Registry of the High Court, Hong Kong SAR; submit to PRC authorities with certified simplified Chinese translation. Do not add consular legalization after the apostille.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Particulars of Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: obtain a certified extract from the Companies Registry, have the signature notarized by a Hong Kong Notary Public, then apply to the High Court Registry of Hong Kong SAR for an apostille. Use the apostilled extract directly; consular legalization is not required for Apostille Convention jurisdictions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution / Power of Attorney authorizing incorporation of the WFOE and appointment of its legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong parent company board of directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path for a Hong Kong parent: notarize the resolution by a Hong Kong Notary Public and apostillize it at the High Court Registry of Hong Kong SAR; provide a certified simplified Chinese translation. If the parent is incorporated in a non-Apostille state, the parallel path is consular legalization only: local notary, competent foreign ministry, then the Embassy/Consulate of the People's Republic of China in that state. The two paths are mutually exclusive and never sequential.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum and Articles of the Hong Kong parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong Companies Registry (certified copy) or Hong Kong parent company secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: certify the copy, notarize it in Hong Kong, then apostillize at the High Court Registry of Hong Kong SAR and translate into simplified Chinese. For a non-Apostille state, use consular legalization in that jurisdiction instead; never combine apostille and consular legalization on the same document.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter addressed to the future bank of the WFOE and to the SAMR/local commerce authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong-licensed bank maintaining the investor's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: the bank officer signs under corporate seal, a Hong Kong Notary Public certifies the signing capacity, and the High Court Registry of Hong Kong SAR issues an apostille. If the branch is in a non-Apostille jurisdiction, obtain consular legalization only; the two methods are mutually exclusive.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every beneficial owner, director, legal representative, and ultimate controlling shareholder against the PRC domestic sanctions list, U.S. Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU consolidated sanctions list, Interpol corruption and PEP databases, and local Administration for Market Regulation disqualification registers. Enhanced due diligence requires negative-media and electronic-verification searches conducted within five business days before submission, source-of-funds documentation, a written risk rating, and a notarized declaration that no disclosed person is a politically exposed person other than cleared and transparent family/close-associate relationships. All records must be retained for at least ten years under the PRC AML Law.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and the Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) online enterprise-name declaration portal, supplemented by the provincial AMR Enterprise Name Independent Declaration platform and the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A WFOE must adopt a legal name in simplified Chinese characters composed of four tiers: administrative division, distinctive trade name of at least two characters, industry or business description, and organization form. The foreign investor name must be transliterated phonetically into standard simplified Chinese characters; pinyin-only, traditional-Chinese-only, and English-only legal names are not accepted. A parallel English trade name is permissible but not the statutory registered name. The name must not be confusingly similar to an existing registration or well-known trademark, must not misdescribe the food manufacturing business, and must not contain prohibited or sensitive words without the prior approval of the relevant ministry.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China, effective as amended on 1 July 2024, in particular Articles 23 to 34 on formation of limited liability companies and Article 47 on the five-year capital subscription period; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China 2019 and its Implementing Regulations; the National Negative List for Foreign Investment Access.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Municipal Market Supervision Administration at the company's registered place of business; foreign investment information reporting through the Ministry of Commerce online portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Establishment Registration and the approved Articles of Association; final statutory instrument: Business License for Enterprise Legal Person.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The PRC Company Law does not impose a minimum amount of registered capital for a general WFOE. The amount is fixed by the shareholder and stated in the Articles of Association. Under Article 47 of the Company Law, subscribers must pay their subscribed capital in full within five years after establishment. No blocked escrow account is required before registration; subscribed capital must be paid into the company's bank account in China and accurately disclosed in the capital ledger and to the SAMR upon call-up.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] WFOE LIMITED. RESOLVED, that the Board of Directors of [Company Name] WFOE Limited (the "Company") hereby ratifies and confirms the incorporation of the Company under the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and the Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China, and approves the Articles of Association as filed with the State Administration for Market Regulation. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered capital of the Company, as stated in the Articles of Association, is hereby acknowledged and the subscription schedule is ratified; the sole shareholder shall contribute the subscribed capital in lawful currency or in-kind assets in accordance with the Articles of Association and the statutory five-year capital payment period; any capital contribution shall be value-certified by a duly licensed certified public accountant where required by law. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company shall be [Registered Address, People's Republic of China], and the Board authorizes the execution of the lease agreement and the use of the premises for the Company's registered office, food manufacturing plant, warehousing, and ancillary administrative functions, subject to zoning and industrial permitting approvals. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following persons are duly appointed as statutory officers: [Name] as Chairman and Legal Representative; [Name] as Director and General Manager; [Name] as Supervisor; and [Name] as Chief Financial Officer. The Legal Representative is authorized to represent the Company in all filings and licensed transactions before governmental authorities, banks, and industrial licensing agencies, within the scope of applicable law. RESOLVED FURTHER, that a corporate operating bank account shall be opened with a licensed commercial bank in the People's Republic of China, and the Legal Representative and Chief Financial Officer, acting jointly or severally, are authorized to complete account opening, signatory designation, wire and SWIFT instruction arrangements, and foreign exchange capital account registration with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange for the lawful receipt of subscribed capital and trade settlement. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Company's corporate seal policy requires that the company chop, financial seal, invoice seal, and contract seal be inscribed with the Company's legal name, guarded under dual-custody, and used only under the joint authorization of the Legal Representative and General Manager, with every use logged. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Board authorizes the filing of all post-incorporation registrations, including tax registration, social insurance registration, food production licensing, environmental impact assessment form submission, and fire safety acceptance, and all officers are directed to execute the necessary dossiers and lawful certificates to commence industrial operation. This resolution shall remain in full force and effect until amended, superseded, or revoked by a duly adopted resolution of the Board or the shareholder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Name Pre-Approval and Foreign Investment Eligibility Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR online Enterprise Name Registration platform of the Municipal Market Supervision Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed English and Chinese trade names through the SAMR name-registration portal for a WFOE limited liability company. Verify that the name contains no prohibited words, is not identical or misleadingly similar to existing registrations, and is compatible with the intended business scope covering manufacturing and aseptic tubing of canned quick-cook tapioca pearls. Confirm that the proposed activity is absent from or compliant with the Foreign Investment Negative List. The legal representative shall provide identity proof and the Hong Kong parent shall furnish certified constitutional documents. The authority issues a Digital Name Pre-Approval Notice valid for six months, which must be cited in the registration application.
required_dossiers: Three proposed company names
Certificate of Incorporation of Hong Kong parent company
Hong Kong Business Registration Certificate
Certified identity document of legal representative
Draft Articles of Association
Application letter confirming business scope and ownership structure
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, promptly amend the name components on the portal and re-file; if the negative-list screening triggers a question, submit a written explanation of the exact product code and license strategy; a formal administrative reconsideration may be filed with the next higher SAMR office within 60 days of the rejection notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Filing and Issuance of Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Market Supervision Administration (SAMR local registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation dossier within the name-approval period. The application includes the signed Articles of Association, shareholder list, supervisor appointment, lease evidence for the registered address, and notarized parent-company documents. After SAMR verifies the identity of the legal representative, the foreign investment information report reference number, and the absence of any negative-list restriction, it issues the Business License for Enterprise Legal Person. The WFOE obtains legal personality on the date of issuance. Confirm that the registered capital subscription period complies with Article 47 of the Company Law and that the business scope expressly includes food production, packaging, warehousing, and domestic and international sale of tapioca products.
required_dossiers: Name Pre-Approval Notice
Notarized/certified Articles of Association
Shareholders' resolution of the Hong Kong parent
Certificate of Incorporation and Business Registration Certificate of the parent
Lease agreement and landlord property certificate for registered address
Identity and qualification documents of legal representative, directors, supervisor, general manager
Foreign Investment Information Report form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a supplementary materials notice, rectify and resubmit within the statutory period; if the application is rejected, the applicant may apply for administrative reconsideration within 60 days or bring an administrative lawsuit within six months, and may simultaneously re-file after curing the identified legal defects.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Authentication, Fiscal Registration and Bank Account Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau-approved engraving firm; State Taxation Administration local tax service hall; local social insurance bureau; State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through a designated bank; licensed commercial bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Business License is issued, the legal representative shall procure the engraved company seal, financial seal, invoice seal, and contract seal at a licensed engraving unit and file the seal impressions with the Public Security Bureau. Register the enterprise for tax and social insurance with the local tax and social insurance authorities using the unified social credit code. Open a RMB basic deposit account and a foreign exchange capital account in a licensed bank, report foreign investment information and, when the Hong Kong shareholder transfers capital, comply with SAFE capital account registration, source documentation, and conversion rules. Any actual paid-in capital shall be disclosed and book-kept.
required_dossiers: Business License for Enterprise Legal Person
Corporate seal registration filing from the Public Security Bureau
Legal representative identity and authorization sheets
Tax registration declaration form
Social insurance registration form
Bank account opening application and beneficial ownership declaration
Articles of Association and registered capital subscription schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax registration or foreign exchange registration is queried, provide supplemental explanations and source-of-funds evidence to the competent tax authority or SAFE-designated bank; if a bank rejects the account, apply to another licensed bank; administrative remedies include rectification, fresh filing, and formal complaint to the tax service hotline or SAFE branch.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Food Production License (SC) Application and Factory Inspection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Market Supervision Administration, Food Production Licensing Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commencing production, submit a Food Production License application under Article 35 of the Food Safety Law for the category of canned quick-cook tapioca pearls and aseptic packaged starch products. Include the production facility layout, process flow, water quality reports, cleaning and sterilization schedules, in-process hazard analysis critical control point plan, and product standards. The licensing authority conducts an on-site factory inspection covering premises, equipment, personnel health certificates, storage tanks, retorting or aseptic tubing systems, package integrity testing, and traceability records. Upon successful inspection, issue the SC Certificate with the licensed food category and valid before the facility commences industrial output.
required_dossiers: Food Production License application form
Business License and Articles of Association
Factory layout and process flow charts
Food safety management system and HACCP plan
Water quality inspection report
Product specifications and applicable national or enterprise standards
Health certificates of production personnel
Equipment list and cleaning validation records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the inspection raises non-conformities, the applicant shall close the corrective actions within the specified period and request re-inspection; if the license is denied, the operator may apply for administrative reconsideration within 60 days, or revise the production conditions and submit a new application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Impact Assessment, Civil Defense Fire Safety Clearance and Occupational Safety Integration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau; Fire Rescue and Civil Defense Department; Municipal Emergency Management Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the construction project environmental impact assessment registration form before installation of production equipment, or if capacity thresholds or sensitive-location criteria require a report, prepare the appropriate EIA document and approval. Obtain plan and use approval for industrial premises, then complete fire-protection design review and fire acceptance inspection for the factory and warehouse, including boilers, pressure vessels, retorts, and ammonia/refrigeration systems. Register special equipment, complete occupational hazard identification for dust and noise generated by cassava starch handling, and obtain the safety production standardization assessment. All environmental and fire clearances must be posted and maintained before first production run.
required_dossiers: EIA registration form or report and approval
Building plan approval and structural safety inspection certificate
Fire protection design review opinion
Fire acceptance inspection record
Special equipment use registration certificates
Occupational hazard evaluation report and control measures
Emergency response plan for fire, chemical spill, and wastewater discharge
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the EIA or fire acceptance is suspended, remedy the identified deficiencies, resubmit technical drawings to the approving bureau, and request reinspection; administrative reconsideration and judicial review are available if the authority wrongfully withholds or delays the clearance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal Market Supervision Administration (SAMR) Food Production Licensing Department, Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau, Fire Rescue and Civil Defense Department, and Municipal Emergency Management Bureau
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Production License (SC Certificate) covering canned and aseptically packed quick-cook tapioca pearls; Food Business License or Internet Food Business Filing, if applicable; Civil Defense Fire Acceptance Certificate.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau under the Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Impact Assessment Registration Form (EIA Registration) for a food-canning and starch-pearl production facility; if annual production capacity or wastewater discharge exceeds the threshold set by the Classified Management List for Environmental Impact Assessment, or if the project is located in an ecological-sensitivity district, upgrade to an EIA Report Form or a Full EIA Report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must comply with GB 8978-1996 Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard, including pH 6-9, COD <=100 mg/L (Grade I) or <=300 mg/L if discharged to a municipal sewage treatment plant, BOD5 <=30 mg/L, SS <=70 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen <=15 mg/L, total phosphorus <=0.5 mg/L, and total cyanide <=0.5 mg/L for cassava-derived processing; boiler gas emissions must meet GB 13271-2014 with particulate matter <=20 mg/m3, SO2 <=50 mg/m3 and NOx <=150 mg/m3 for gas-fired boilers; VOCs from cleaning and disinfection processes must be captured; hazardous waste, including sludge and chemical containers, must be stored in compliance with GB 18597-2023 and transferred under the electronic hazardous-waste manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Fire Acceptance Certificate from the local Fire Rescue Brigade covering the manufacturing plant, warehouse, and office, including fire-resistance of structures, exit capacity, fire hydrant pressure, automatic alarm and suppression systems; structural load inspection for retort and storage tanks; special equipment registration and inspection for boilers, pressure vessels, and elevators; Work Safety Law clearance requiring a safety production responsibility system, emergency evacuation plan, and annual drills; occupational hazard evaluation under the Workplace Occupational Hazards Prevention Law covering dust, noise, high temperature, and chemical exposure controls.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; local administrative tax bureaus exercise delegated supervision; the statutory online filing and registration portal is the unified Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Taxation) platform, supplemented by the National VAT Invoice Verification Platform administered by the STA.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) The WFOE is first established through the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR); the China business license carries the 18-character Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which is simultaneously accepted by the tax authorities as the entity's Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and VAT registration number. 2) SAMR transmits the registration data electronically to the competent tax bureau, completing the one-stop tax registration; the WFOE itself does not need to submit a separate TIN application. 3) The legal representative and financial officer must complete real-name authentication on the Electronic Tax Bureau portal, bind the WFOE's tax registration, and confirm the taxpayer identity attributes, including resident enterprise status, industry codes, VAT taxpayer type, and tax collection jurisdiction. 4) The WFOE must then verify or elect its VAT classification: if annual taxable sales do not exceed CNY 5,000,000, it may remain a small-scale taxpayer; if the threshold is exceeded or export zero-rating/input-VAT refund is intended, it must register as a VAT general taxpayer through the VAT General Taxpayer Registration function in the e-Taxation portal. 5) For the foreign non-resident investor, typically the Hong Kong SAR parent company, no Chinese TIN is required for merely holding shares in the WFOE; the WFOE acts as the withholding agent for China-source dividends and remits withheld tax using the parent's home-jurisdiction tax identification number, supported by a Hong Kong tax-residence certificate where treaty benefits are claimed. 6) If the foreign non-resident entity itself becomes liable to register for Chinese tax because it carries on business in China, has a permanent establishment, or supplies taxable services in China, it must file a non-resident tax registration/filing declaration with the competent tax bureau, supported by the foreign certificate of incorporation, articles of association, board resolution, power of attorney, identity documents of the authorized representative, and notarization, legalization or apostille as applicable under the Hong Kong-Mainland document certification arrangement, together with a Chinese translation; after verification the tax bureau assigns a Chinese tax identification number for the non-resident entity and opens its access to the e-Taxation portal. 7) All subsequent changes to registered information, bank account details, legal representatives, ownership, address, or business scope must be filed through the e-Taxation portal within 30 days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None of the U.S.-style check-the-box elections or hybrid-mismatch elections are available under PRC tax law. The only material statutory election is the VAT taxpayer status election: an entity with annual taxable sales not exceeding CNY 5,000,000 may elect small-scale taxpayer status, but an exporting production enterprise that needs the 0% export VAT and export input-tax refund treatment must be a VAT general taxpayer; registration as a VAT general taxpayer is compulsory once annual taxable sales exceed CNY 5,000,000.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) of the People's Republic of China under the PRC VAT Interim Regulations and the STA export tax rebate administration system.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic turnover threshold triggers basic VAT registration: every PRC-incorporated WFOE must complete VAT registration upon issuance of its SAMR business license. For VAT taxpayer classification, the small-scale taxpayer threshold is annual taxable sales of CNY 5,000,000; exceeding this threshold mandates compulsory VAT general taxpayer registration. Export-related 0% VAT treatment and export rebate eligibility are generally available only after VAT general taxpayer status is in place.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The STA mandates the Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoice (e-invoice) framework under the Golden Tax Phase IV architecture. Every statutory VAT invoice, including the VAT special invoice used for input-VAT credit, is issued through the STA's Electronic Invoice Service Platform; the tax authority pre-assigns the invoice code and unique invoice number, and the complete invoice data is transmitted to the STA in real time before or at the moment of issuance, constituting the Chinese fiscal clearance event. The e-invoice carries a cryptographic anti-fraud tax-control authorization stamp in place of the former physical paper stamp and fiscal-device seal. Enterprises must integrate their ERP billing systems with the e-Taxation API or use the e-Taxation module, authenticated with a tax-control UKey or STA-compliant digital certificate. Red-letter credit notes, void invoices, and revisions are processed through the central platform with tax authority authorization; recipients verify e-invoices in real time on the National VAT Invoice Verification Platform. Legacy tax-controlled invoice equipment and paper invoices continue to be phased out under the provincial tax bureau transition schedules.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the PRC VAT export tax rebate rules, goods manufactured in China and physically exported outside China's customs territory are subject to 0% VAT on the export sale, with input VAT attributable to the exported goods credited and refunded under the production-enterprise exemption-credit-rebate method. The WFOE must meet all of the following statutory criteria: (1) it is registered as a VAT general taxpayer; (2) the canned boba tapioca pearls are sold to an overseas buyer and the goods are physically exported through a PRC customs port, evidenced by an accepted Customs Export Declaration; (3) export sales proceeds are repatriated through permitted banking channels and the export collection is reported in SAFE's Trade in Goods Foreign Exchange Monitoring System; (4) the export value, product codes, quantities, units, destination, and payment terms are consistent across the commercial invoice, customs declaration, transport documents, and foreign exchange receipt record; (5) input VAT on raw materials and production costs directly attributable to the exported goods is substantiated by valid VAT special invoices or customs VAT payment vouchers; and (6) the product-specific export rebate rate, which may be equal to or lower than the 13% standard rate, is correctly applied in the exemption-credit-rebate calculation. Relevant qualifying offshore digital services are not part of this manufacturing scope.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (export Bill of Entry) issued by China Customs with the accepted declaration number and release/discharge record
Original or express release Bill of Lading, or Air Waybill where applicable, evidencing transport from a PRC export customs port to the overseas buyer
Foreign Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or bank-issued foreign exchange receipt confirmation showing the export proceeds credited to the WFOE's PRC domestic account
Zero-rated export commercial invoice and packing list
Export sales contract or purchase order with the overseas buyer
Export tax refund/exemption-credit-rebate declaration e-form generated by the STA Export Tax Refund Management System
Valid VAT special invoices and, if imported inputs are used, customs VAT payment vouchers evidencing the input VAT recovered on export
SAFE export collection report record or the corresponding Trade in Goods Foreign Exchange Monitoring System entry
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA and China Customs cross-check the Customs Export Declaration, e-invoice data, logistics bills, VAT special invoices, export rebate declarations, and SAFE export-collection records through automated data matching. If the 0% VAT export treatment cannot be substantiated or if any document is inconsistent, the tax authority may retroactively claw back the refunded input VAT, reverse the export zero-rating and assess output VAT at 13% on the affected export sales, impose late-payment surcharge at 0.05% per day, and impose a tax evaded penalty of 50% to 500% of the tax amount under Articles 63 and 64 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law of the People's Republic of China. Cases involving fabricated exports, counterfeit customs declarations, fraudulent input-invoice credits, or proceeds not repatriated within the statutory FX monitoring window are treated as export tax refund fraud; criminal liability arises under Article 204 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, which provides for heavy fines, imprisonment, and confiscation, and the entity will be listed in the national tax dishonesty blacklist, potentially triggering restrictions on finance, customs clearance, and foreign exchange operations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime under the PBOC/SAFE framework. The current account is largely convertible for genuine trade and service transactions; banks perform authenticity and consistency checks on commercial invoices, contracts, customs declarations, and tax vouchers before allowing FX purchase/sale or RMB cross-border settlement. The capital account remains restricted: inbound equity capital to a WFOE must be registered as FDI with SAFE, wired into a designated capital account, converted at a licensed bank, and verified by a Chinese CPA before use. Profit remittances to the HK parent are permitted as dividends under the current account, but only after the company has filed and paid enterprise income tax and any dividend withholding tax, submitted an audit report, board resolution, and a foreign exchange payment application. If the WFOE posts no substantive operating activity, SAFE can challenge round-tripping or cross-border financing misclassification. Convertibility is therefore real but documentary; the bank is the first line of compliance. Currency convertibility is unrestricted for trade-related current items, but every transaction must have an economic substance and a clean audit trail.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All goods-export FX receipts must be repatriated to a domestic licensed bank account and reported in the SAFE Trade Foreign Exchange Monitoring System. There is no mandatory conversion ratio since the trade FX reform; exporters may retain the FX in a settlement account or sell it to the bank at market rate. Receipts should match the underlying export customs declaration and invoices. If payment is not received within 90 days after the export date, the WFOE must proactively register the delayed collection with SAFE before the deadline. Cross-border RMB receipts are settled via CIPS and are not subject to FX surrender.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of China Limited, Shanghai or Shenzhen Branch
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account) and Basic Operational RMB Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited, Shanghai Branch
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Foreign Exchange Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: China Construction Bank Corporation, Guangzhou Branch
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational Currency Account and Import/Export Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: China Merchants Bank Co., Ltd., Shenzhen Branch
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Trade Services Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Non-viable as a primary account provider. Mainland China does not license foreign fintech EMI/digital banks to hold domestic deposits or provide resident local account/clearing services for a WFOE. Instruments from Wise, Revolut, Airwallex, or similar can only be ancillary payment initiation/collection channels in Hong Kong; all onshore funds must sit in and clear through a locally licensed commercial bank under PBOC and CBIRC supervision. Using an offshore EMI for WFOE liquidity creates a settlement and AML regulatory gap and is not a compliant treasury solution.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The WFOE legal representative, or a board-authorized senior manager holding a valid Chinese visa and a notarized power of attorney, must normally appear in person at the branch during initial account opening. Non-resident directors of the HK holding company and remote UBOs cannot fully avoid KYC; their passports and corporate documents must be notarized or legalized at a Chinese embassy or consulate, and the bank may arrange a live video interview. Banks also reserve the right to conduct a physical site visit to the factory to verify the production line, warehouse, and staff headcount.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border ownership chain with a Hong Kong intermediate layer obscuring the ultimate beneficial owner and source of inward capital injection.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Hong Kong Certificate of Incumbency, Register of Directors and Shareholders, audited financial statements of the parent, passport copies and address proof of all UBOs, source-of-wealth letters with bank statements, asset portfolios, or tax returns, CRS self-certification forms, and a group structure chart with commercial rationale.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering red flags on canned boba exports: inconsistent invoice amounts, multiple currencies, or mismatch between customs declarations and payment tickets.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed sales contracts, purchase orders, commercial invoices, packing lists, full set of clean on-board bills of lading, China customs export declarations, third-party inspection and HACCP certificates, freight forwarding receipts, and a transaction-level reconciliation of LC and TT collections.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulatory scope gap for ISIC 1030 food manufacturing: bank must confirm the WFOE is lawfully engaged in edible food production rather than using a general trading license to pass through funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business license with explicit food manufacturing scope, China Food Production License (SC), GACC export food producer registration, ISO 22000 or HACCP certificate, factory lease, pollutant discharge permit, and product specification or shelf-life documentation for canned boba.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP or sanctions-list name match against foreign shareholders or end buyers in Hong Kong or the receiving market.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed PEP questionnaire, sanctions screening report with timestamp from a recognized provider, notarized passport scans of all named individuals, corporate ownership chain chart, and a narrative explanation of the underlying commercial relationship and source of funds prepared for the bank compliance committee.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The HK parent wires registered capital to the WFOE through the SAFE-approved FDI capital account. Before dispatch, the WFOE obtains the SAFE FDI Business Registration Letter and opens the capital account with a licensed bank. The remittance instruction must use the SAFE purpose code for FDI capital injection, state the WFOE corporate name and FDI registration number, and the receiving bank will convert USD or HKD to RMB at market rate. A Chinese certified public accountant must issue a capital verification report after receipt. Capital account funds cannot be applied to cross-border loan repayment, securities, or entrusted loans unless separately permitted. If the HK parent provides intercompany shareholder loans, the loans must be registered with SAFE and repaid under a documented facility agreement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For export sales of canned boba, the WFOE should use SWIFT MT103 TT collections or export letters of credit (SWIFT MT700) with bills of lading and inspection certificates. The receiving bank will match each FX credit to the China customs declaration, commercial invoice, and packing list. For upstream purchases of tapioca starch, sugar, packaging, and flavoring, the WFOE can issue outward MT103 or MT202 payment orders or import LCs; the payment purpose code must be a goods-trade code, and import customs declarations must be archived at the bank. Documentary collections are permissible for repeat low-risk buyers, but LC and direct TT are the preferred clearing rails. Cross-border RMB settlements can be cleared through CIPS rather than conventional FX surrender, while USD and HKD clearing remains on SWIFT.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts with a licensed onshore bank, grounded on forecast export or import exposure and SAFE trade documentation.
FX swaps (USD/RMB or HKD/RMB) for short-term working capital timing mismatches between export receipts and raw-material payments.
OTC currency options with real trade exposure underlines and bank-approved option premium documentation.
Cross-currency swaps only if the WFOE has long-term foreign-currency bank debt or RMB-denominated obligations; the swap notional must not exceed the underlying debt.

Onshore CNY non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are prohibited for a mainland WFOE; only deliverable forwards are permissible. Offshore CNH NDFs should be avoided as they are speculative and outside the SAFE hedge documentary framework.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Hong Kong Annual Return (Form NAR1) with updated register of members
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the anniversary date of incorporation each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties under Companies (Fees and Penalties) Regulation: HKD 300 if overdue up to 3 months, HKD 700 if over 3 to 6 months, HKD 1,100 if over 6 to 9 months, HKD 2,200 if over 9 to 12 months; responsible officers may be prosecuted with a maximum fine of HKD 50,000 plus HKD 1,000 per day of continuing default; if unfiled for 12 months or more, the Registrar may strike the company off under the Companies Ordinance, dissolving the company and causing its assets to vest in the Government.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Hong Kong Business Registration Certificate annual renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Inland Revenue Department, Business Registration Office, Hong Kong SAR
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the expiry date shown on the current Business Registration Certificate; late renewal is possible only within a grace period of one month after expiry on payment of the statutory late fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs a late fee of HKD 300 if renewed within one month after expiry and HKD 900 or HKD 1,000 in longer lateness periods; operating without a valid Business Registration Certificate is an offence subject to fine and prosecution; persistent non-renewal is treated as evidence of cessation of business and may be a trigger for administrative strike-off by the Companies Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Hong Kong Profits Tax Return (PTR) together with audited financial statements and tax computation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Inland Revenue Department, Hong Kong SAR
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of the issue date of each Profits Tax Return, unless the Inland Revenue Department grants an extension for e-filing, typically to early-to-mid November for standard fiscal year-end companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may result in estimated assessments, fines up to HKD 10,000, court prosecution, and interest on overdue tax; prolonged non-compliance may lead to distraint, bankruptcy or winding-up proceedings, and unresolved tax liabilities may disqualify the company from deregistration and good-standing certification.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Hong Kong Employer's Return (BIR56A and IR56B forms) for all employees
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Inland Revenue Department, Hong Kong SAR
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 April each year for the year of assessment ending on 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Employer failure to file is an offence subject to fines up to HKD 10,000 per offence, estimated assessments on employees, prosecution action, and adverse treatment during IRD compliance checks; persistent non-compliance can result in penalty tax and may affect annual renewal and good standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: PRC WFOE Annual Information Report to SAMR including integrated Foreign Investment Information Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, with integrated Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) foreign investment information reporting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January through 30 June each year covering the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file by 30 June leads to inclusion in the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operation within 10 working days; if the default remains unremedied for three consecutive years, the WFOE is placed on the List of Seriously Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprises, which triggers administrative blacklisting, enhanced supervision, restrictions on the legal representative and directors, refusal of registration changes, credit and forex/customs consequences, and in serious cases SAMR may revoke the business license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: PRC Corporate Income Tax annual return, final settlement, and payment of any balance of tax due
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the local tax bureau at the WFOE's administrative registration place
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May of the following tax year for a calendar-year accounting period; quarterly instalments are due within 15 days after each quarter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts administrative fines up to RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to 10,000 where the non-filing is serious; late payment attracts a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the underpaid tax; the tax authority may freeze and seize bank deposits or other property, restrict exit of the legal representative, and initiate forced enforcement, which also undermines the WFOE's annual compliance status with SAMR and foreign investment authorities.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit is not threshold-based for either the PRC WFOE or the Hong Kong company. For a Hong Kong-incorporated private company, every company must obtain audited financial statements annually; a company may qualify as a small private company if it satisfies at least two of the following three quantitative tests: annual revenue not exceeding HKD 20 million, total assets not exceeding HKD 10 million, and not more than 100 employees, but those tests only permit application of HKFRS for Private Entities and simplified reporting; they do not create an audit exemption. For the PRC WFOE, PRC Company Law and Accounting Law require annual financial statements to be independently audited by a qualified PRC-registered CPA firm for every company, including every wholly foreign-owned enterprise, with no turnover, balance-sheet, or headcount exemption available for foreign-invested enterprises.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC WFOE: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS), in substance converged with IFRS. Hong Kong: Hong Kong Financial Reporting Standards (HKFRS); eligible small private companies may apply HKFRS for Private Entities. The ultimate Hong Kong consolidation, if any, follows HKFRS or IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Hong Kong has no separate UBO annual confirmation filing; however, every Hong Kong company must maintain a Significant Controllers Register (SCR) at its registered office or prescribed place and enter changes of significant controllers within 7 days after becoming aware of the change. For the PRC WFOE, beneficial-owner and actual-controller information must be confirmed annually through the SAMR annual report and integrated MOFCOM foreign investment information report, due by 30 June each year. In addition, shareholding transfers, changes in shareholder identity, and changes in actual controllers trigger a 30-day statutory reporting window: the WFOE must update the register of shareholders and file the corresponding change of registration with SAMR within 30 days of the change. Missing the 30-day filing exposes the WFOE to abnormal-operation blacklisting, penalties, and possible ineffectiveness of the transfer against bona fide third parties.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: HK registered office and company secretary: USD 400-1,200 per annum; PRC WFOE registered address and local compliance/tax agent: USD 500-1,500 per annum; combined typical range USD 900-2,700 per annum.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: PRC WFOE statutory audit: USD 3,500-9,000 per annum; Hong Kong holding company audited financial statements: USD 2,000-6,000 per annum; combined group audit and secretarial support market range: USD 6,000-15,000 per annum.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard 25% headline; preferential 15% rate for Qualified High-Tech Enterprises; 15% rates under special regional and Western China investment policies; R&D super deduction of 100%; small low-profit enterprise preferential rates apply to qualifying income; canned tapioca pearl manufacturing does not automatically qualify for agricultural income exemption unless directly engaging in primary agricultural production.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return for Resident Enterprises (Form A) with supporting schedules (A100000, A105000, A105050, A105080, A107010, A107012, A108000, etc.); filed electronically through the State Taxation Administration electronic tax affairs platform (e-Tax).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return with quarterly provisional filings; the annual return is due by May 31 of the following tax year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual filing must be completed within 5 months of the end of the tax year, i.e., on or before May 31; quarterly provisional payments and preliminary returns are due within 15 days after the close of each taxable quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross worldwide sales revenue from canned boba tapioca pearls, net of sales discounts and returns. For cross-border sales to Hong Kong related parties, the price must be at arm's length under China's transfer pricing rules; any year-end transfer pricing adjustment affecting revenue must be reflected in this box, and a related-party transaction reporting schedule must be filed. Revenue must not be re-routed to the Hong Kong affiliate without genuine distribution, value creation, and risk assumption.

Include raw tapioca starch, canning materials, direct labor, factory overheads, and production depreciation actually incurred, supported by lawful invoices and vouchers. If raw materials or services are purchased from a Hong Kong affiliate, the price must be consistent with the approved Cost Plus or TNMM methodology; penalties arise for false self-invoicing or circular shell purchases. Any service charges hidden in cost that constitute royalties or fees to non-residents must be separately analyzed for withholding tax.

Deduct consumption tax, city maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, real property tax, land use tax, stamp duty, environmental protection tax and other invoice-backed taxes paid in China. Taxes borne by a foreign parent, for example Hong Kong profits tax, are not deductible in the WFOE. Non-resident shareholders may not aggregate their separate tax liabilities here.

Report freight, export packaging, e-commerce channel commissions, trade promotions, and warranty expenses. Commissions or overseas marketing fees paid to Hong Kong brokers require evidence of actual services, arm's length commission rate, and withholding of income tax at 10%, with possible treaty relief. Without a valid withholding declaration, the expense will be disallowed and penalties assessed.

Include rent, executive salaries, audit, legal, insurance, amortization, and office expenses. Intercompany management fee payments to the Hong Kong parent must be supported by contracts, actual provision of services, and no policy dividend disguised as a fee; royalty payments for tapioca technology or trademarks must comply with the royalty WHT regime and the economic substance of the licensed IP. Payment of group fees without receipts or with circular transactions triggers non-deduction and severe penalties.

Deduct interest expense on Chinese bank loans and related-party loans subject to the thin capitalization debt-to-equity ratio (2:1 for non-financial enterprises, 5:1 for financial enterprises). Interest paid to Hong Kong lenders triggers 10% statutory WHT, and treaty relief of 7% is available if the lender is the beneficial owner, obtains a Hong Kong Tax Residency Certificate, and has no permanent establishment in China. Any interest capitalized to an asset must not be expensed currently.

Add back non-deductible items including fines, penalties, over-limit charitable donations, excessive entertainment expenses above the statutory cap, non-compliant invoices, losses from related-party transactions not at arm's length, and transfer pricing increases imposed by the tax administration. Cross-border adjustment red flags include informal transfers without exchange contracts, settlement through third-country accounts, and discrepancies between customs declarations and invoice amounts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax-exempt income, loss reduction, and super-deduction items.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report qualifying investment earnings such as dividends from Chinese resident companies, gains from transfer of land development rights, and super deductions for R&D expenses and hiring of disabled personnel. Non-resident shareholders cannot claim Chinese tax treaty credits on this return; the WFOE may claim a deemed deduction for qualifying intellectual property commercialization only for domestically licensed technologies with a patent box-like arrangement.

This is the net taxable base after all adjustments, prior-year loss deductions, and special tax recoveries. Loss carryforward is limited to five years, or ten years for qualifying high-tech or sci-tech SMEs. Losses from foreign branches or from a Hong Kong holding company cannot be used to offset Chinese manufacturing profits. Confirm no negative taxable income results from aggressive intercompany pricing.

Apply the statutory or concessionary rate (25% standard, 15% for qualifying high-tech, etc.) to taxable income; subtract quarterly prepayments, overseas tax credits for taxes paid by the WFOE on foreign-source income, and any already-paid structural adjustments. Do not include the shareholder-level dividend withholding tax; that obligation is discharged by the distributing entity when the board approves distributions to the Hong Kong parent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fixed penalty of RMB 2,000, up to RMB 20,000 for serious violations, plus a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax for each day of delay; late payment may trigger enforcement measures, asset seizure, and an exit restriction on the legal representative. Intentional understatement or fraudulent returns constitute tax evasion under Article 63 of the Tax Collection Administration Law, with penalties of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax and potential criminal prosecution under Article 201 of the Criminal Law, including imprisonment up to seven years and fines.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% withholding on dividends distributed by a Chinese resident enterprise to a non-resident corporate shareholder before treaty relief; the WFOE must act as withholding agent and remit the tax within seven days of the distribution or as prescribed.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim the Mainland-Hong Kong DTA reduced rate of 5% for dividends when the Hong Kong beneficial owner holds at least 25% of the WFOE's capital, and 7% for interest and royalties, the taxpayer must: (1) obtain a Hong Kong Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the Inland Revenue Department for the relevant fiscal year; (2) file the non-resident tax treaty benefits information reporting form through the e-Tax portal before or with the payment, attaching the TRC, audited financial statements, and a beneficial ownership declaration showing entitlement to the income; (3) ensure the Hong Kong recipient is the real economic owner and not a conduit, has substance in Hong Kong, and does not employ the WFOE as a permanent establishment; (4) upon acceptance, the payer withholds at the treaty rate. If approval is not obtained in time, the 10% statutory rate must be withheld; the excess can be reclaimed by the non-resident within three years by filing a treaty relief request with the competent tax authority.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rates are 10% for interest and 10% for royalties paid to non-resident enterprises. Under the Mainland-Hong Kong DTA, interest paid to a Hong Kong resident beneficial owner is capped at 7% and royalties at 7%, provided the recipient substantiates beneficial ownership with a TRC and no permanent establishment in China. Service fees paid to a Hong Kong affiliate that carry the character of royalties or are embedded in product prices must also be separated and reported.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File preparation is mandatory where annual related-party transactions exceed one of: RMB 200 million for tangible asset transfers, RMB 100 million for financial asset transfers, RMB 100 million for intangible property transfers, or RMB 40 million for all other related-party transactions (including services, management fees, and loans); a Master File is required when the consolidated annual revenue of the multinational group exceeds RMB 5.5 billion. These thresholds trigger mandatory contemporaneous documentation, which must be submitted within 15 days of a tax authority request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not have an offshore Economic Substance Regulations regime, but the GAAR under Article 47 of the EIT Law and the substance-over-form doctrine require the WFOE to perform genuine manufacturing, employ personnel, own equipment, carry risk, and make substantive managerial decisions in China. The canned boba production process, including pearl cooking, canning, aseptic tubing, and quality inspection, must be the Core Income-Generating Activity of the Chinese entity; artificial allocation of profit to a shell Hong Kong entity without employees, assets, or functions will be recharacterized. For the Hong Kong parent or affiliate, Hong Kong ESR, if classified as a relevant entity, remains applicable in Hong Kong, and the Chinese WFOE must support any contractual allocation with third-party evidence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Fraudulent Cross-Border Invoicing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting false export declarations, understating revenue from sale of boba pearls to Hong Kong buyers, overstating related-party raw material purchases, or fabricating service fee invoices from the Hong Kong affiliate to shift profits out of China without any actual transaction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 63 of the PRC Tax Collection Administration Law, tax evasion is penalized by an amount equal to 50%-500% of the underpaid tax; Article 201 of the Criminal Law imposes criminal liability for evasion exceeding RMB 50,000, with imprisonment of up to three years, or seven years for especially large amounts; Article 205 of the Criminal Law on false VAT special invoices imposes from three years to life imprisonment and fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A court may pierce the corporate veil under Article 23 of the PRC Company Law (2023 revision) if shareholders or directors abuse corporate independence; directors who sign fraudulent tax returns are jointly and severally liable for restitution of the corporate tax, face asset freezing and bank account seizures, can be placed on the tax exit-control blacklist, which includes a travel ban prohibiting departure from China, and may personally receive criminal imprisonment terms of up to seven years, along with confiscation and fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Lack of Economic Substance in Cross-Border Structure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the WFOE as an empty shell with no actual factory team, production equipment, inventory, or business decision-making in China, while booking all manufacturing profits into the Hong Kong entity and paying excessive royalties or management fees back to Hong Kong for fictitious technology.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The GAAR under Article 47 of the EIT Law gives the tax authority power to restructure or disregard an arrangement that lacks reasonable commercial purpose; a reassessment may disallow all related-party deductions, reallocate profit to China, impose a penalty of up to 50% of the adjusted additional tax, and demand interest on the underpaid tax; treaty benefits are denied under the beneficial ownership and principal purpose test; the tax authority may additionally issue a public penalty and credit rating downgrade.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the entity is a mere conduit, shareholders and directors can be held personally liable for corporate debts under the Company Law veil-piercing provision; directors who produce false substance documentation may face civil damages to creditors, a SAFE or tax blacklist that includes an exit ban, and criminal exposure for fraudulent fact-finding, including imprisonment for tax crimes; the legal representative may be barred from leaving China while the enterprise has overdue undisputed tax liabilities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Foreign Exchange Violations in Concealed Profit Remittance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using underground banks, cash couriers, or third-country shell accounts to remit dividends, interest, royalties, or related-party loan repayments to Hong Kong without going through legitimate SAFE foreign exchange procedures or without reporting and withholding tax obligations; also receiving export proceeds in private accounts to avoid taxation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 39 of the PRC Regulations on Foreign Exchange Administration, illegal cross-border fund transfer is penalized with 5%-30% of the illegal amount; non-withholding of tax on outbound payments triggers penalties equal to 50%-300% of the unwithheld amount under the Tax Collection Administration Law; money laundering under Article 191 of the Criminal Law carries a maximum sentence of ten years, plus fines and confiscation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who orchestrate or approve underground remittances are subject to civil liability for the company's resulting losses, individualized SAFE and customs travel bans, freezing of personal assets, disqualification of the legal representative, and criminal imprisonment for money laundering or tax evasion; if foreign exchange fraud causes severe losses, responsible directors may be personally sued and held liable for the entire shortfall in tax and FX penalties, and asset recovery proceedings may be initiated against their personal holdings.
